bib.title: Retrieval-Augmented Multimodal Language Modeling
bib.venue: Proceedings of the 40th International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML), PMLR 202, 2023

question: Can a multimodal generator that retrieves and conditions on text and image documents from an external memory beat a non-retrieval multimodal model on image and caption generation at lower training compute?
hypothesis: Storing knowledge in an external memory rather than in parameters lets a smaller model train with less compute and generate more faithful images and captions.
contributions: First retrieval-augmented multimodal model that can retrieve and generate both text and images (RA-CM3)
Mixed-modal CLIP dense retriever plus retrieval strategy (relevance, modality, diversity)
Retrieval-augmented CM3 generator trained with joint loss on main and retrieved documents
Strong MS-COCO results at <30% of DALL-E compute, plus faithful generation and multimodal in-context learning

method.summary: A frozen CLIP ViT-L/14 bi-encoder retrieves up to 2 multimodal documents (text and image averaged, L2-normalised) from a FAISS flat index of the 150M LAION training pairs. They are prepended to the input of a 2.7B CM3 Transformer trained from scratch with loss on main plus retrieved docs (alpha 0.1). Evaluated zero-finetune on MS-COCO.
method.task: retrieval-augmented text-to-image and image-to-text generation (CM3 causal masked LM over HTML-formatted image/text tokens)

datasets.name: LAION subset
datasets.source: LAION (Schuhmann et al., 2021), cleaned following Stable Diffusion preprocessing; same 150M used as external memory
datasets.preprocessing: filtered out images with watermark probability above 0.5, unsafe probability above 0.5, or resolution below 256x256; each pair formatted as '' with image as 1024 VQGAN tokens

models.name: RA-CM3
models.architecture: CM3 Transformer decoder with retrieved docs prepended
models.tokenizer: VQGAN image tokenizer (1024 tokens per image)

models.name: CLIP ViT-L/14
models.architecture: frozen off-the-shelf text and image encoders, mean pooled

training.objective: L = L_main + alpha L_retr (CM3 token prediction on main and retrieved docs), alpha=0.1; retriever fixed; CM3 infilling objective
training.batch_size: 16 sequences per GPU; model parallelism over 4 GPUs
training.regularisation: gradient clipping 1.0; Query Dropout (20% of query tokens)

other.query: text part or image part of the document used as query in training

inference.samples: text-to-image: 10 images per caption, top by CLIP score; image-to-text: 32 captions per image, top by perplexity; qualitative figures: 256 images re-ranked by CLIP
inference.prompting: retrieved docs prepended as in-context examples; k-shot classification by averaging probabilities over k single-pair passes
inference.retrieval: CLIP ViT-L/14, FAISS Flat index MIPS over 150M docs, K up to 2 (ensemble for more at inference); skip candidates with relevance score > 0.9 to query or already retrieved (Avoid Redundancy); retrieval under a second

other.super_resolution: off-the-shelf (Rombach et al., 2022) for qualitative figures

metrics.name: FID
metrics.definition: generate images for MS-COCO val captions, compare with ground-truth images

metrics.name: CIDEr
metrics.definition: captions for MS-COCO val images vs ground-truth captions

metrics.name: k-shot accuracy
metrics.definition: binary ImageNet classification with non-semantic labels

eval.protocol: no finetuning; single run, no seeds or significance tests stated; vanilla CM3 matched on architecture, data and compute

evidence.quote: The model is trained from scratch for five days on 256 A100 GPUs.

limits: No finetuned numbers reported for RA-CM3, and FID gap to Imagen (7.27), Re-Imagen (6.88) and Parti (7.23) remains.
Retriever is frozen CLIP; co-training or finetuning retriever left as future work.
Memory is the same 150M LAION data as training, so no test of an unseen or updated memory.
K limited to 2 by 4096 context; larger K only via ensemble; K>2 not helpful for MS-COCO captions.
Qualitative figures only for knowledge-intensive generation and editing; no quantitative faithfulness metric.
Single run; no seeds or significance tests; no code or weights link in text.
Model is a research prototype; authors warn against generating images of people; data may hold biases.
